name: New patient visit
description: Consultation, full exam, X-rays if needed, and your first adjustment.

name: Adjustment
description: A focused follow-up visit: re-check, adjust, and progress your plan.

name: Extended visit
description: An adjustment plus soft-tissue work for stubborn or multi-area problems.

name: Pregnancy care
description: Webster-certified adjustments on a pregnancy table, every trimester.

name: Active Release Technique
description: Hands-on release for tight, scarred or overworked muscles.

name: Rehab exercise session
description: One-to-one strength and mobility work so the fix lasts.

name: Kinesiology taping
description: Supportive taping for knees, shoulders and low backs between visits.

name: Six-visit plan
description: Six adjustments to use within ten weeks, booked around your schedule.

name: Monthly maintenance
description: Two visits a month for people who want to stay ahead of it. Cancel anytime.
